## 🐛 Fixed

- Browsing a bucket in the web UI works again. The UI looked for Garage's config in `/etc/garage.toml` instead of `/config/garage.toml`, so it sent its S3 requests to an empty address and failed with `dial tcp :80: connect: connection refused` ([#19](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/garage/issues/19)). Existing installs pick up the fix with a plain container update; nothing in `/config` changes.
